entities.summary: Henning Harnisch is a retired German professional basketball player. At a height of 2.03 m tall, he played at the small forward and power forward positions. He currently serves as vice president for the German Basketball Bundesliga team Alba Berlin, and is in charge of Alba's youth program. In addition to that, he is the China ambassador for Alba Berlin.
